routes.dop853: DOP853 from the Taylor germ (reference only)
routes.pinn: plain residual PINN: tanh MLP 4-32-32-1, raw residual Delta_c H' - N
routes.rf: random-feature tanh x Chebyshev network, defect loss (AI-designed)

design.reduction_constants: g=C1=C2=1, anchor (r,H)=(1,1), C3/G fixed by the anchor
design.stratum: generic: R and T_c admitted for every (m,K,G,f,g,c); rank-two orbits

drift.model: E1 uniform drift, exact U=(U0^m-x/2)^(1/m), kappa=1/2, alpha=1/4, g=C=1, E=2
drift.route: rf readout (6 Chebyshev x 15 features), integral defect loss

training.domain_oracle: training nodes beyond the DOP853 reach of each training tuple are dropped (no profile labels)
